222-527-4885-8249.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-4885-8249.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Defiant Salvager twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

4279-6248-7286--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
4279-6248-7286--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, South Wind Avatar, Phenomenon Investigators and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the South Wind Avatar trigger, causing you to gain life. Its second ability then triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Phenomenon Investigators ability, creating a 2/2 Horror creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, South Wind Avatar triggers, causing you to gain life. Its second ability then triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

391-2645-3430-4717.easyPrerequisites: Blossom Dryad doesn't have summoning sickness.
391-2645-3430-4717.description:
Activate City of Traitors by tapping it, adding six {C} due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Activate Blossom Dryad by tapping it, untapping City of Traitors
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Blossom Dryad.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1395-5078-7060-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska and Elsha's prowess ability trigger.
Resolve the Elsha trigger, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn
Resolve the Vraska trigger, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1887-2034-5254.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature with power 4 or greater.

3175-5617-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Fungal Fortitude triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Fungal Fortitude from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
3175-5617-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

640-1981-2415-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a creature, adding one mana of any color
When the creature dies, Dross Harvester and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Dross Harvester trigger, causing you to gain 2 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Repeat.

requires.n: Gives +1/+1 counter to creatures that enter

2438-4186-6566--196.description:
Cast Scurry Oak by paying its mana cost.
When Scurry Oak enters, the effect that adds +1/+1 counters to entering creatures triggers or applies its replacement effect, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, that same effect causes you to place at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Yuna triggers, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak
Repeat steps 3 and 4 once.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat from step 5.

997-6854--5--195.notablePrerequisites: At least one persist creature has a +1/+1 counter on it.
997-6854--5--195.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the persist creature that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, its persist ability and Host of the Hereafter trigger.
Resolve Host of the Hereafter's ability, putting at least two +1/+1 counters onto the surviving persist creature due to the counter-increasing effect.
If that creature had a -1/-1 counter on it, remove that and one of the +1/+1 counters from it as a state-based action.
Resolve the persist ability from step 2, returning the persist creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability from step 1.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3010-3259-6965.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3010-3259-6965.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Moonblade Shinobi, triggering Breath of Fury and Moonblade Shinobi.
Resolve the Moonblade Shinobi trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

676-1309-1987.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
676-1309-1987.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creature tokens.
676-1309-1987.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Salvager of Secrets.
When Salvager of Secrets enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
676-1309-1987.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

549-2685-4017-4186.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
549-2685-4017-4186.description:
Gain life in any way.
Scurry Oak triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Biotransference.
Teething Wurmlet triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

1017-1494-5435-7720.description:
If you have six or more cards in hand, activate Dream Trawler by discarding a card.
Repeat step 1 until you have five or fewer cards in hand.
At the beginning of your end step, The Ten Rings triggers, causing you to draw cards until you have ten cards in your hand.
Wizard Class triggers for each card drawn, putting that many +1/+1 counters on Sage of Hours.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1479-3147-7705.description:
Play Azorius Chancery.
When Azorius Chancery enters the battlefield, it, Mole Man, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Azorius Chancery trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Mole Man trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Azorius Chancery from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Azorius Chancery enters the battlefield, it and Mole Man trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

969-1368-3755-6321.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
969-1368-3755-6321.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

359-372-7487.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Acrobatic Maneuver exiled by Abdel Adrian.
359-372-7487.description:
Cast Acrobatic Maneuver by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Zealous Lorecaster and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Zealous Lorecaster trigger.
Resolve the Zealous Lorecaster trigger, returning Acrobatic Maneuver from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Acrobatic Maneuver.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Zealous Lorecaster and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

1402-3593-4359-5147.description:
Activate Sneak Attack by paying {R}, putting Diamond Lion from your hand onto the battlefield.
Activate Sneak Attack by paying {R}, putting Garna from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Garna enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Diamond Lion by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Garna.
Resolve the Garna ability from step 3, returning all creature cards that were put in your graveyard this turn to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1251-1563-3129-3899.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

uses.n: Avatar Aang // Aang, Master of Elements

2450-7117.description:
Cast Whim of Volrath with buyback by paying {0} due to Aang's cost reduction, returning Whim of Volrath to your hand.
Repeat.

997-6754-7084.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Eusocial Engineering triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

requires.n: Extra Turn Spell - GY on Resolution

5256-6490-6991--88.notablePrerequisites:
You have enough mana available each turn to cast the extra turn spell and enough mana each extra turn to cast Donnie & April.
You have not cast a spell using Kotis
5256-6490-6991--88.description:
Cast the extra turn spell by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your extra turn.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Donnie & April, causing you to mill cards equal to Donnie & April's power.
Cast Donnie & April from your graveyard by paying its mana cost and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, ensuring not to exile the extra turn spell.
When Donnie & April enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning the extra turn spell from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1818-3967-5010-6900.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 3.
1818-3967-5010-6900.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Golgari Thug.
When Golgari Thug dies, it triggers, putting it from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Cast Golgari Thug from the top of your library by paying 2 life.
When Golgari Thug enters, Healer of the Pride triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat.

549-856-5686-6748-6757.description:
Cast Cauldron Familiar by paying {B}.
When Cauldron Familiar enters, it and Weapons Manufacturing trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Weapons Manufacturing trigger, creating a Munitions artifact token.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing the Munitions, as it is a Food due to Ragost.
The Munitions triggers, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

3661-4779-5220-6900.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Shield Sphere
When Shield Sphere dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Shield Sphere from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability.
Cast Shield Sphere from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

1878-2713-3454-4539-5795.easyPrerequisites: An opponent has six or more cards in hand.
1878-2713-3454-4539-5795.description:
Activate Sunforger by paying {R}{W} and unattaching it, searching your library for Jeska's Will and casting it without paying its mana cost, adding at least six {R}.
Activate Sunforger's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to Zirda.
Activate Sunforger by paying {R}{W} and unattaching it, searching your library for Unexpected Windfall and casting it without paying its mana cost and discarding a card.
Resolve Unexpected Windfall, causing you to draw two cards and create two Treasures.
Activate Sunforger's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to Zirda.
Activate Barkform Harvester twice by paying {2}, putting Unexpected Windfall and Jeska's Will from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {W}{W}.
Repeat.

147-2034-6476.manaNeeded: {1}{R}{R} plus enough mana and/or cards in your graveyard to cast Afterlife from the Loam
147-2034-6476.description:
Cast Afterlife from the Loam by paying at most {5}{B}{B}{B}.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Afterlife from the Loam.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Afterlife from the Loam, targeting Dualcaster Mage and any other creature(s) as desired.
Resolve the copy of Afterlife from the Loam, returning the targeted creatures from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1636-2292-6095.notablePrerequisites:
You have a Zombie creature card in your graveyard.
Creatures you control can tap to produce enough mana to cast the Zombie in your graveyard.
Zul Ashur does not have summoning sickness.
1636-2292-6095.description:
Activate Zul Ashur by tapping it, targeting a Zombie card in your graveyard.
Activate any number of creatures you control by tapping them, adding enough mana to cast the Zombie.
Cast the Zombie from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
When the Zombie enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the Zombie, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

224-2692-5627.notablePrerequisites:
Wight of the Reliquary does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional creature.
224-2692-5627.description:
Activate Wight of the Reliquary by tapping it and sacrificing another creature, causing you to search your library for a land card and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Felidar Retreat and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Felidar Retreat trigger, creating a 2/2 Cat Beast creature token.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Wight of the Reliquary.
Repeat.

3487-4374-5870.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two energy counters.
3487-4374-5870.description:
Activate Aethergeode Miner by paying {E}{E}, blinking it.
When Aethergeode Miner enters the battlefield, Aetherstorm Roc and Guide of Souls trigger, causing you to get {E}{E} and gain 1 life.
Repeat.

717-1742-4798-5686.description:
Activate Skirge Familiar by discarding Ovalchase Daredevil, adding {B}.
Bone Miser's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Activate Shilgengar's first ability by sacrificing the Zombie, creating a Blood token.
When the Blood enters the battlefield, Ovalchase Daredevil triggers, returning Ovalchase Daredevil from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

requires.n: Land with Cycling Cost that can be paid using {B}{B}

717-5671--37.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to pay for the cycling card's cycling cost.
717-5671--37.description:
Activate the cycling card's cycling ability by paying its cycling cost and discarding it.
Bone Miser's second ability triggers, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the cycling ability, causing you to mill two cards and return the cycling card from your graveyard to your hand due to its dredge ability.
Repeat.
If the cycling land has a cycling cost that can be paid using {B} or less, this combo nets near-infinite black mana.

2527-4073-4076-4549-5634.notablePrerequisites: Burakos does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
2527-4073-4076-4549-5634.description:
Cast Merciless Executioner by paying {2}{B}.
When Merciless Executioner enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Relic of Legends' second ability by tapping Burakos, adding {B}.
Burakos triggers, giving it and all creatures you control that share a creature type with it +2/+0 and undying until end of turn.
Resolve the Merciless Executioner trigger from step 2, causing you to sacrifice Burakos, and each opponent to sacrifice a creature.
When Burakos dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Retribution of the Ancients by paying {B} and removing the +1/+1 counter from Burakos, giving Merciless Executioner -1/-1 until end of turn.
Merciless Executioner dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering its undying ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter from it.
Repeat steps 2 through 6 one additional time.
Activate Retribution of the Ancients by paying {B} and removing the +1/+1 counter from Burakos and Merciless Executioner, giving Merciless Executioner -2/-2 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 8.

880-3875-4677.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature, causing you to search your library for a land card with a basic land type and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield Tireless Provisioner and Zendikar's Roil trigger.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Zendikar's Roil trigger, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

2825-3263-3525-4036.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Elite Arcanist.
Elite Arcanist does not have summoning sickness.
2825-3263-3525-4036.description:
Activate Elite Arcanist's ability by paying {3} and tapping it, casting a copy of Seething Song without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Seething Song, adding {5}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {1}, untapping Elite Arcanist.
Repeat.

1734-2150-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Fiend Hunter, adding one mana of any color.
When Fiend Hunter dies, its second ability triggers, returning Hero of the Dunes to the battlefield from exile.
When Hero of the Dunes enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Hero of the Dunes.
Repeat.

561-1168-1651-5077.description:
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Scaretiller and another artifact, targeting Scaretiller.
Scaretiller triggers, returning Maestros Theater from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Maestros Theater enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Toggo.
Resolve the Toggo trigger, creating a Rock equipment token.
Resolve the Maestros Theater trigger, causing you to sacrifice it then search your library for a basic Island, Mountain, or Swamp and put it onto the battlefield.
If you put a land onto the battlefield this way, Toggo triggers, creating a Rock equipment token.
Resolve the Clock of Omens ability from step 1, untapping Scaretiller.
Repeat.

280-1168-1479.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
280-1168-1479.description:
Play Golgari Rot Farm.
When Golgari Rot Farm enters the battlefield, it, Toggo, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Toggo trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Golgari Rot Farm from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Golgari Rot Farm enters the battlefield, it and Toggo trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

224-433-765.description:
Activate Llanowar Scout by tapping it, putting Guildless Commons from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Guildless Commons enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Guildless Commons trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Llanowar Scout.
Repeat.
